q: My buyer wants only the emissions for the goods I supplied them. How do I work that out?
title: Emissions for one buyer's orders
short: Share your plant's emissions for the period by a physical measure, such as tonnes or pieces, in proportion to that buyer's orders. If products differ a lot, allocate by line or by machine hours first. State the method so the buyer can compare suppliers.
audience: Suppliers answering a buyer's request for its share of emissions

ol: Plant Scope 1 and 2 for the period.
Output in the chosen unit for all customers.

p: If the buyer's products use a different process or much more energy, split emissions by line first, then share within the line.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted plant records, so the monthly intensity behind a compliance figure can be traced to its source.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard

example.title: Example: one buyer
lines: Plant emissions 1,200 t CO2 a year
Buyer's share of output: 250 of 2,000 t = 12.5%
